title: Settings
description: How people sign in and how hop sends email.

password.title: Password sign-in
password.allow: Allow signing in with a password
password.allowHint: When this is off, people sign in with single sign-on or a passkey. You can only turn it off after single sign-on is set up.

sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.description: Let people sign in with your company account (Google Workspace, Microsoft, Okta, Keycloak and others).
sso.discoveryHint: The address of your provider's OpenID configuration, usually ending in /.well-known/openid-configuration.
sso.clientSecretSet: Leave empty to keep the current secret.
sso.label: Button text
sso.autoCreateHint: Anyone who signs in with an allowed email gets an account. When this is off, only people who were invited or already have an account can sign in.
sso.domainsHint: Separate with commas, for example acme.com, acme.io. Leave empty to allow any domain.
sso.redirectHint: Add this address in your provider as an allowed redirect.

email.title: Email
email.description: Used to send invitations and password reset links. Without it, you share those links yourself.
email.fromEnvironment: Email is currently set up by the server configuration. Saving a server here replaces it.
email.passSet: Leave empty to keep the current password.
